note: Plain mode reads the offer tiles on 20 Nov 2026: the index uses richtext tiles (span.heading-5 merchant name) and the category listings use div.offer-card tiles (bold merchant name, div.offer-desc headline); both have, a one-line headline and a 'View Offer Details' button. Dead tiles on 20 Nov 2026 (404): lifestyle/regional-golf-programme/enhancedgolfprogramme.html and shopping/10Xcelerator/10Xcelerator.html. Proof Living (ended 30 Sep 2026) and travel/singapore-airlines (a standing card earn rate, no offer dates) are not offers.
